title: A kept Claude Bash operation whose result never arrives holds a carried gate uncredited until its six-hour expiry
outcome: A provisional Claude Bash operation whose runtime stays alive but whose result never arrives (a lost denial result, a call interrupted without a tool_result) resolves within a bounded time, for example at turn end or on a turn-generation change, instead of keeping its carried gate uncredited until the six-hour carried-check expiry refuses it.
acceptance: A kept Claude Bash operation whose result never arrives holds a carried gate uncredited until its six-hour expiry is done
